dimensional.title: Measure. Compare. Verify.
dimensional.description: We utilize Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) for tactile inspection of linear dimensions, form, and complex geometric tolerances. With the ZEISS DuraMax, we handle general-tolerance projects (≥ 0.02 mm). For tighter requirements and high-demand geometries, we deploy the ultra-high-precision ZEISS PRISMO.

optical.title: High-resolution non-contact measurement.
optical.description: Using the ZEISS O-Inspect, we inspect sensitive parts and components that cannot undergo mechanical probing. The system combines optical and tactile measurement, alongside the DotScan sensor, capable of capturing the topography of reflective, transparent, or hard-to-read surfaces.

xray.title: See what cannot be seen.
xray.description: With ZEISS Bosello, we perform non-destructive testing to evaluate internal structures and discontinuities invisible to conventional methods, identifying defects based on material density.

scanning.title: Transform physical geometry into digital data.
scanning.description: We capture complex geometries to produce high-fidelity 3D models for dimensional analysis, quality control, and reverse engineering. The T-SCAN Hawk 2 provides portable flexibility for on-site measurement, while the ATOS Q delivers maximum point density for intricate components.

reverse.title: From physical part to parametric CAD model.
reverse.description: We reconstruct exact component geometries from point clouds and 3D meshes, delivering solid or surface CAD models ready for manufacturing, replacement, or design optimization.
